g0_baseline.summary: B-01 undefined 'Tuple' annotation fixed (builtin tuple[...]); pkgutil-wide import regression test added; uvicorn boots; pytest green on local 3.14 with CI proving 3.12 strict annotations.

g1_real_asr.summary: SpeechRecognizer protocol with three explicit providers: mock | openai (POST /audio/transcriptions) | openai-chat (POST /chat/completions with data-URI input_audio, probed live on Alibaba Bailian compatible-mode). Fail-fast without keys, never a silent mock fallback. 20 offline contract tests + live smoke: 3/3 SAPI-synthesized adult-script WAVs correctly transcribed; full browser pipeline drill 11/11; 2 human real-voice sessions.

g2_session_lifecycle.summary: Strict half-duplex (mic gated by voiceState), flowEpoch stale-response guard, ASR failure forces NEW recording (budget 1, original never resent), natural finish auto-deletes server session, 180s duration cap + 60s idle timeout both ends, 404 recovery, exit stops speechSynthesis + recorder tracks; no dialogue content in any browser storage. Live-verified: natural finish deletion (benign /end 404), exit /end 200, half-duplex observed in drill and human sessions.

g3_privacy_safety.summary: Honest privacy copy, guardian confirmation gate before mic, input-side PII self-disclosure/injection guard (EN+CN) with help-seeking never silenced, transcript never echoed to client, bounded 5MB audio/* uploads, per-session 12/min rate limit, credentials server-side only, robot identity in prompt. Live backend-log audit during real-voice acceptance: 0 transcript/model-response text in logs. docs/privacy-and-pilot-gates.md 已核查13/待核查8(A1 供应商已选定,留存条款仍待归档)。

g4_ci_evidence.summary: .github/workflows/ci.yml committed (pytest on 3.12 + vitest + build, mock-only, no secrets); .env.examples complete; README overhauled with measured counts; acceptance checklist restructured into 4 gate categories + failure drill matrix; evidence files written.

latency_note: n=3 per-turn speech-API latencies from the automated real-ASR/LLM drill (p90 of n=3 ~= max = 9035ms). Checklist target 'p90 <= 3000ms' NOT MET — recorded honestly. Decomposition (measured on gateway, warm): ASR qwen3-omni-flash ~3.1-3.9s + LLM qwen3.8-flash ~2.8-3.8s + upload. Config-level alternatives exhausted (qwen3-asr-flash and qwen-audio-3.0-asr-flash reject data-URI; faster omni variants slower; LLM alternates within noise). Reaching <3s requires a streaming/realtime-WebSocket ASR architecture — post-MVP work.
